summary: book --confirm sends the full captured confirm payload (ISO datetime, pre-auth/agreements, dry-run-resolved staffer) and parses appointment_uid; adds --payment-method and --note.
reason: The generated book command reconstructed the confirm endpoint by convention. A real captured booking showed the confirm POST needs the fuller payload and, for prepayment businesses, a payment_method id.
validated_outcome: Confirm payload validated against the live dry_run endpoint (HTTP 201); 113 live dogfood checks pass.
